brief.headline: Bounce Theory climbs to 127.6K views; topic captions lift TikTok
brief.summary: Bounce Theory's 28-day views rose again, from 97.4K yesterday to 127.6K (+99 subs), and Ambient Escape climbed to 29.3K, led by verse-reminder Shorts. On TikTok, followers are still flat at 178, but the shirt video, your first in weeks with a caption that says what it's about, is your best recent post at 346 views, so keep the topic in the caption and on screen. New today: the AI Opportunities team ran for the first time and its top pick is a 'Google-ready' tune-up plus your NFC review stand for local shops.
filmToday: TikTok: Lock in for Ramadan, not January — Everyone's locking in till December 31st. I think we picked the wrong finish line.
TikTok: The liking gap: they liked you more than you think — Psychology says the person you just talked to likes you more than you think.
YouTube (Bounce Theory): Soft Body 0% vs 100% Escape — Frame 1: three glowing jelly blobs (0%, 50%, 100% soft) already falling into three stacked spinning rings.
approvals: 31 ideas wait for your review across all teams (12 TikTok, 10 R&D Lab, 3 each Growth, LinkedAI, Opportunities)
Top: TikTok: Lock in for Ramadan, not January
Top: Growth Architect: Every AI marketing plan said 'post consistently'
Top: R&D Lab: Marble Run Special: Bounce Theory's first real long
Waiting on Omar: YouTube: Soft Body 0% vs 100% Escape
Waiting on Omar: YouTube: Spiral Chain Reaction (every wall hit splits)
Waiting on Omar: YouTube: Blizzard Cabin Fireplace + Brown Noise 3 Hours
notes: Best R&D Lab upgrade: Marble Run Special, one continuous marble race (the format is at 2.27M views, 21.7x) instead of 0-11-view compilation longs. The YouTube team already planned it as today's long, but it's still pending your call in the Lab. Keyword-first TikTok captions is the runner-up.

Best new AI opportunity: 'Google-ready' profile tune-up + NFC review stand for Mississauga shops ($149-249 one-time). 56% of 100 simulated owners backed it if they can pay after the fix and never share passwords.
The LinkedAI team hasn't run since Oct 26 (about 49 hours), so its 3 ideas are getting stale.
